name: Marracat
subtitle: Discover your next favorite
description:
Discover brands and find your next favorite.

Marracat brings fashion, beauty, home essentials, and more together in one place. Explore brands, compare products, and keep the finds you love close at hand.

EXPLORE BY DEPARTMENT
Browse categories and detailed shopping aisles to find what you need, from bags and clothing to skincare and home goods.

DISCOVER BRANDS
Explore brand storefronts and featured picks. Refresh Home to discover more while keeping our premier brands within reach.

SEARCH YOUR WAY
Search products, brands, and categories. Helpful suggestions make it easy to narrow down your next find.

MAKE IT YOURS
Sign in with Apple or Google to sync your likes, searches and completed-checkout records across devices. Discover recommendations inspired by your searches, saved items and recent views. Mark items not interested, clear history or turn personalization off whenever you like. You can also browse and shop as a guest.

YOUR ORDERS AND CHECKOUTS
Revisit completed in-app checkouts and see order references and totals when the brand provides them. Shipping, returns and live order status are managed by the brand. Purchases completed on external websites may not appear in Marracat.

SHOP DIRECTLY WITH THE BRAND
Supported brands open their checkout inside the app. Each brand handles its own payment, shipping, and returns; carts containing multiple brands use separate checkouts. Other products link to the brand's website.

Product prices and availability can change. The brand confirms final pricing, shipping, taxes, and availability at checkout.
promotionalText: Find your next favorite. Explore fashion, beauty, home goods, and more, save your picks, and shop directly with each brand.
reviewNotes:
Marracat is a shopping discovery app for physical goods. Browse and checkout are available without signing in. The You tab offers Apple and Google sign-in for account-based saved items, search/view history, recommendations and checkout records. Guest data stays on the device unless explicitly imported at sign-in. Signed-in data syncs with Marracat. Carts remain device-local and isolated by account.

You includes personalization opt-out, clear history, an in-app privacy policy, sign-out and account deletion with the same provider identity confirmation. Apple-linked deletion also revokes Apple authorization. Recommendations use Marracat activity, not cross-app tracking.

Supported products open the brand's Shopify checkout inside the app. Other brands open their website. Completion callbacks can provide an order reference, total and currency. Shipping, fulfillment and returns remain with the brand; external website purchases may not report completion. No digital purchases, subscriptions or combined multi-brand checkout are enabled.

Users can hide their email with Apple. Apple and Google identities stay separate, with no automatic email-based linking. Public review is pending App Privacy declarations and device verification of Apple sign-in.
